fact: The state digital operator's page says its cybersecurity actions follow the national cybersecurity strategy (SNC2022); the page carries no date, so the year is inferred from its 2022 footer and no strategy period is stated.

The Direction générale du chiffre et de la sécurité des systèmes d'information (DCSSI) is stated to co-organise the second cybersecurity providers forum and to set the course and norms for cybersecurity.

Senegal's National Assembly adopted in plenary on 20 August 2026 the bill that institutes a national cybersecurity authority with legal personality, backed by a national CERT; promulgation is not stated.

fact: The adopted law classes systems of national defence, public security, the courts, the prison administration and customs as critical information infrastructure by operation of law, and requires operators to report serious incidents to the Authority within 24 hours.
